commits.message:
feat(core): add getSelectedText() API method

Adds getSelectedText() to the EditorAPI interface and implements it
using CodeMirror's sliceDoc, which correctly handles both forward
and reverse selections.

- Added getSelectedText(): string to EditorAPI in types.ts
- Implemented in editor.ts using view.state.sliceDoc(anchor, head)
- Added tests covering: empty selection, forward selection, reverse selection

Closes the P0 roadmap item for getSelectedText().

fix(core): handle reverse selection in getSelectedText and add dev notes

- Normalize anchor/head with Math.min/max before calling sliceDoc
- Add __test_getView() helper for direct selection dispatch in tests
- Update tests to use EditorView.dispatch() instead of setSelection() (jsdom limitation)
- Add docs/getSelectedText-dev-notes.md documenting the dev process and gotchas

feat(core): add OpenSpec proposal for getSelectedText() API

Adds OpenSpec change proposal for the new getSelectedText() API method,
including proposal.md, tasks.md, and spec delta for editor-core.

docs(core): update README and types for getSelectedText() API

- Add getSelectedText() to API Reference in README.md and README.zh.md
- Add __test_getView() to EditorAPI interface (internal, for testing)
- pnpm build passes

refactor(core): remove __test_getView, use setSelection() in tests

- Removed __test_getView() from EditorAPI interface (types.ts)
- Removed __test_getView() implementation from editor.ts
- Updated editor.test.ts to use editor.setSelection() directly
  instead of accessing internal EditorView via __test_getView
- All 29 tests pass
